prompt.project_info: Create a dynamic low-angle portrait of an approved adult East Asian woman under a clear blue sky.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult East Asian woman with long straight dark-brown hair, natural dewy skin, bright engaging eyes, white surgical mask, oversized pale-yellow open shirt, opaque salmon-pink ribbed top, and opaque white knee-length shorts, raising a peace sign.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme low-angle 20mm heroic framing against a uniform cerulean sky, central subject, raised hand near the top edge, one leg subtly bent, jacket draped naturally, no body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Crisp high-key daylight, defined but natural shadows, cool blue sky fill, vibrant saturated clean modern color, cheerful open-space energy.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A1 or RED Komodo-style detail, 20mm f/1.8, deep focus, 1/800s, ISO 64, daylight white balance, 16:9 or 1.85:1 cinematic crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A dynamic extreme low-angle heroic portrait of an approved adult East Asian woman under a clear cloudless cerulean sky. She has long straight dark-brown hair, natural dewy skin, bright engaging eyes, a pristine white surgical mask, an oversized pale-yellow open shirt, an opaque salmon-pink ribbed top, and opaque white knee-length shorts. She stands in a confident but natural power stance with one leg subtly bent, raises a crisp peace sign near the top edge, and keeps the jacket draped naturally. Use a 20mm f/1.8 wide lens, deep focus, crisp high-key daylight, cool blue-sky fill, strong but natural shadows, ISO 64, 1/800s, daylight balance, vibrant modern color, and clean cinematic framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, late-teen ambiguity, crop tank, short shorts, exposed midriff, bust emphasis, hip emphasis, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
